in_marathi.name: Yajnabhuj
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Offerer of Yajna
in_marathi.long_meaning: Yajnabhuj हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Derived from Yajna (sacrifice, worship, oblation) and Bhuj (one who offers).

in_bengali.name: Yajnabhuj
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Offerer of Yajna
in_bengali.long_meaning: Yajnabhuj একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। Derived from Yajna (sacrifice, worship, oblation) and Bhuj (one who offers).
